acceptance: Jim retains owner disposition; independent semantic assessment is separate; no acceptance judgment is supplied.
historical_provenance: Preserve original parent provenance as historical evidence and append exact parent, current F_P authoring, source manifest and semantic patch coordinates.

invalidation.rule: A changed parent, source bytes/inventory, codec, explicit patch, interpreter, oracle, authoring or contract requires separate reevaluation; refuse changed bindings rather than refresh historical studies.

limits: No new whole-source generation or regeneration of frozen studies.
No whole-model semantic equivalence, global governing closure or full-calculus qualification.
No fresh upstream Graphify build/export trial, actor usability, efficiency, installation, RC or release claim.
mapping: Inherit all eight parent populations, signature, exact record identities, ordering, source grounding, residuals and source dispositions. Replace exactly the explicit target exception string in semantic-patch.json. The one target identity is retained within a separately identified model; this is not a claim of semantic equivalence to the defective parent.

source_reentry.rule: Re-enter exact frozen raw source paths and line witnesses. The corpus manifest and every frozen source file are checked before packaging/replay.

stop_states: refused: exact input or application scope differs

structural_evaluation.claim: Declared structural fragment, exact allowed delta, proposed carrier materialization and exact recovery only. No generic predicate execution or AC-013 transformation claim.
